title: Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep
abstract: arXiv:2611.32802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. translated_title: 基于睡眠机制的样本高效上下文适应
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.32802v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从有限经验中学习并泛化的能力，即样本效率，是智能的基石。我们如何构建能够将少量用户交互、几段陌生代码或上下文中提供的少量实验结果转化为可泛化知识的语言模型？先前的研究发现，“睡眠”——即模型执行 N 次循环前向传递以精炼其对一段上下文表示的过程——可以改善长上下文推理（具体而言，在 SSM-注意力混合模型中）。我们研究这种方法是否也能改善Transformer语言模型在一般性、非合成任务上的上下文适应能力。为此，我们使用睡眠机制在多达 1000 亿 token 上预训练了参数量高达 12 亿的语言模型。值得注意的是，更长的睡眠（即使用更多的循环前向传递次数 N）使模型能够在多个少样本算法任务上更快地进行上下文学习……
tldr: 该研究提出在Transformer语言模型预训练中引入“睡眠”机制（通过多次循环前向传递精炼上下文表示），显著提升了模型在一般性任务上少样本上下文学习的样本效率。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a "sleep" mechanism during pre-training of transformer language models—performing multiple recurrent forward passes to refine context representations—substantially improving sample efficiency of few-shot in-context learning on general tasks.
